title: Warranty Coverage Labor on Technician Visits — Billing Desk Card
content:
Warranty Coverage prices the labor for a completed technician visit on a warranty claim that the warranty terms bill labor for, which is a visit outside the labor term, and books it on the warranty charges of the registration with its billable labor hours, dated with the date of the visit and tied to the claim the visit served. The charge is the labor alone: the trip charge on such a visit is not priced by it, and a visit inside the labor term still carries no labor charge for the covered repair.

## What the billing tool does

`bill_visit_labor_b6354c72` bills the labor for one completed technician visit on a warranty claim. One call adds one labor charge entry to the warranty charges of the registration, dated with the date of the visit, tied to the claim the visit served, carrying the claim's component, the billable hours and the labor amount. The amount owed by the registered owner rises by exactly that labor amount. Nothing else on the registration or the claim changes; the owner can see the new labor charge on the warranty charges of the registration.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_visit_labor_b6354c72` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_registration_id` | the registration the visit was made under, as returned by the warranty registration lookup | identifier |
| `warranty_claim_id` | the warranty claim the visit served, as returned by the warranty claim lookup or shown on the visit in the warranty activity lookup | identifier |
| `visit_date` | the date of the technician visit exactly as shown on that visit in the warranty activity lookup; it becomes the date of the labor charge | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `billable_hours` | the billable labor hours of the visit as the warranty labor terms define them, the hours the labor amount is priced on | decimal hours to 1 decimal place, non-negative |
| `amount` | the labor charge owed for that visit | USD, a positive amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A receipt with `warranty_activity_id` (the reference of the new labor charge entry), `warranty_registration_id` (the registration billed), `warranty_claim_id` (the claim the charge belongs to), `charge_kind` (always `labor_charge`), `activity_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the charge carries), `labor_hours` (decimal hours to 1 decimal place) and `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the charge booked). A receipt carrying a `warranty_activity_id` means the labor charge is now on the registration's warranty charges.
